card.name: Punctuation inside stock label phrases
card.fires_on: Single connecting marks or words inside fixed label phrases: the slash or .gov in NIH Genetics Home Reference web addresses, the comma after 'nearly all antibacterial agents', and 'see' in '[see Warnings and Precautions'.
